about: Sunrise Workshop · My shop — tools for an agent (MCP). Each tool maps 1:1 to window.workshop.execute(name, args) in the portal tab.
playbook: 0. First time: admin.status → if todo has admin.profile.set / admin.wallets.add, ask the person for name, contacts, city and wallet address(es) once. Every later site (shop.compose / shop.start) takes them automatically.
1. shop.questionnaire → ask the person only these questions (short, one message).
2. Photos: the person drops them into the portal or sends them to you → intake.add → "asset:<id>".
3. shop.compose {about, items, banner, address, contact} → read "missing".
4. Ask for what is missing → shop.photo / shop.banner / shop.payment.set / shop.set {contact}.
5. shop.missing is empty (or only photos) → shop.finish {as:"dataUrl"} → give the person the file to send. For a web link: shop.export {as:"site"} and publish on static hosting.
Never invent prices or wallet addresses. Prices at most 2 decimals (the last 4 of 6 USDC decimals carry the order number).

tools.name: portal.open
tools.description: Open a place in the portal by name. "открой админку" → admin; "открой бухгалтерию" → accounting (admin → Бухгалтерия, totals across all wallets); "кошельки" → wallets; "мои данные" → profile; "проверь хеш" → hash; "примеры" → presets; "собрать сайт" → shop.build; "счета" → billing.

tools.name: shop.questionnaire
tools.description: Questions to ask the person before building a mini-site (shop + price list + business card). Ask them in order, briefly.

tools.name: shop.recipes
tools.description: Kinds of sites the composer knows: goods, collection, handmade, services, single, rental, food.

tools.name: shop.compose
tools.description: Build the whole site from the answers in one call: sections, texts, icons, colours from a recipe; photos and banner loaded; wallet checked (EIP-55). Returns sections with ids and what is still missing. Refuses to overwrite a site being built unless replace:true (the old one goes to "my sites"). Wallet and contacts carry over from the previous site when not given.

about.description: What the person sells, in their words: "барахло из подвала", "моя коллекция VHS"

photo.description: Image: "asset:<id>" from the Inbox (intake.add), a data: URL, or an https URL

receiver.description: Own EVM address of this item (multi-seller)

banner.description: Image: "asset:<id>" from the Inbox (intake.add), a data: URL, or an https URL

address.description: EVM address for USDC on Base

tools.name: shop.photo
tools.description: Put a photo on an item, found by cellId or by part of its title.

image.description: Image: "asset:<id>" from the Inbox (intake.add), a data: URL, or an https URL

tools.name: shop.banner
tools.description: Set the banner of a section (index 0 = first screen).

image.description: Image: "asset:<id>" from the Inbox (intake.add), a data: URL, or an https URL

tools.name: shop.payment.set
tools.description: Wallet: shared address (USDC on Base) or a per-item receiver; order number in the amount on/off.

tools.name: shop.set
tools.description: Change texts and settings: brand {name, place, stripLeft, stripRight, logo}, hero {title, sub, …}, contact, footer, theme, credit.

tools.name: shop.section.add
tools.description: Add a section (banner + tab) with optional cells.

tools.name: shop.section.patch
tools.description: Edit a section by sectionId.

tools.name: shop.cell.add
tools.description: Add an item to a section.

tools.name: shop.cell.patch
tools.description: Edit an item (price, text, stock, hidden…).

tools.name: shop.missing
tools.description: What is still needed before the site is useful: prices, photos, banner, wallet, contact — with the exact question to ask.

tools.name: shop.finish
tools.description: Pack the site into ONE html file (no owner cabinet inside) and show the Pack tab. as:"dataUrl" returns the file to send in a messenger; as:"download" saves it. blockers lists what prevents payments.

tools.name: shop.export
tools.description: Same file, or as:"site" — a zip with index.html for Netlify Drop / Cloudflare Pages / GitHub Pages.

tools.name: shop.sites
tools.description: My sites (current + earlier ones).

tools.name: shop.switch
tools.description: Open an earlier site.

tools.name: intake.add
tools.description: Bring a photo into the portal Inbox first (returns assetId); then use "asset:<assetId>" as an image.

tools.name: admin.open
tools.description: Open the shop admin panel (back office) on a page. If the result says unlocked:false, call admin.unlock.

tools.name: admin.unlock
tools.description: Enter the admin. The password is a placeholder for now: no check.

tools.name: admin.status
tools.description: What is done and what is left: profile, wallets, current site and its missing items, todo commands.

tools.name: admin.profile.get
tools.description: Owner data saved in the admin.

tools.name: admin.profile.set
tools.description: Save owner data once; it flows into every new site (contacts, place, logo). applyToCurrent:true also writes it into the current site.

tools.name: admin.wallets.list
tools.description: All wallets (USDC on Base) with labels; the default one goes into new sites.

tools.name: admin.wallets.add
tools.description: Add a wallet. Address is checked with EIP-55; never invent addresses — only ones the person gave.

tools.name: admin.wallets.patch
tools.description: Rename a wallet or make it default. Find it by id, label or address.

tools.name: admin.wallets.remove
tools.description: Take a wallet out (kept in history as "снят").

tools.name: admin.apply
tools.description: Write the admin data (contacts, place, logo, default wallet) into the current site.

tools.name: admin.accounting
tools.description: "Открой бухгалтерию": read every wallet from the Base chain → total incoming, balances, payments with order numbers. show:false to not switch the screen.

tools.name: admin.hash
tools.description: Check one payment by transaction hash when the order number in the amount was lost: how much USDC came, to which wallet, from whom, which item it looks like. handedOver:true marks it as handed over.

tools.name: admin.publish
tools.description: "Опубликовать для ИИ": readiness checks, set the public site URL (https) used in schema.org / products.json, preview llms.txt. Opens the admin page.
